[EN] Unforeseen Effects
[ES] Efectos imprevistos
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I will."
[ES] "Lo haré."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ask Rogand where Hagand is.
[ES] Pregúntale a Rogand dónde está Hagand.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "No time like the present."
[ES] "No hay mejor momento que el presente."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ask Hagand for directions to Diranas Quarry.
[ES] Pídele indicaciones a Hagand para llegar a la cantera Diranas.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Test the Old Invisibility Potion.
[ES] Prueba la poción de invisibilidad vieja.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You feel nauseated. That potion went bad years ago.
[ES] Te sientes con náuseas. Esa poción se echó a perder hace años.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Get started, then. I'll bring back the ingredients."
[ES] "Empieza entonces. Yo traeré los ingredientes."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Consult with Hagand.
[ES] Consulta con Hagand.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Gather Reflective Roots from the nearby meadows.
[ES] Recolecta raíces reflectantes en los prados cercanos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill Deformed Fangspawns for Foggy Eyeballs.
[ES] Mata a los colmillos deformes para conseguir globos oculares neblinosos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Take your time. Do it right."
[ES] "Tómate tu tiempo. Hazlo bien."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Bring Reflective Roots and Foggy Eyeballs to Hagand.
[ES] Llévale las raíces reflectantes y los globos oculares neblinosos a Hagand.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Got it."
[ES] "Entendido."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Accept invisibility potion from Hagand.
[ES] Acepta la poción de invisibilidad de Hagand.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
